name: figma-ds-builder
description: Figma → дизайн-система → вёрстка с проверкой pixel perfect

scripts.setup: npm --prefix packages/builder install && npm --prefix packages/plugin run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/builder test && npm --prefix packages/plugin test && node tools/i18n.mjs --check
scripts.bench: npm --prefix packages/bench install && npm --prefix packages/bench run bench
